band.title: Waiting for files
band.empty: Nothing is asked. Ask anyone for a file: a person, a role, a team on the floor or the customer.

counted.priced_one: {count} ask for a file with prices
counted.why: your role does not read them.

band.closed: This order is closed: no new asks.

menu.label: More for Waiting for files
menu.copyLink: Copy link to Waiting for files

info.what: One row per open ask: the ones asked of you first, then what arrived, then what is late. An ask closes only with files sent for it: then Accept, or Ask again.
info.who: A floor ask names a team, a floor role or a step — never a worker; nothing says who read it.

band.failed: Couldn't read the asks. The rest of the tab is shown.

who.STEP: the floor · whoever works the step

held.checking: Wait — the file is being checked.

ask.title: Ask for a file
ask.whatHint: The uploader sees these words on top of their upload window · 3–500 characters.

whoHint.OFFICE_ROLE: everyone with it who reaches this order
whoHint.FLOOR_ROLE: the tablets of that role at the site

ask.pickFailed: Couldn't read who can be asked: try again.
ask.officeNote: Only people who reach this order and its customer get it; nobody with the role reaching it: the window says so before you send.
ask.floorNote: Teams, floor roles and steps only: a floor worker is never named, and the tablets never say who read it.
ask.customerNote: {customer} gets a task in its portal: upload a document. Your words stay in the office.

whereKind.WORK_ORDER: A work order and its step

ask.floorWhere: A floor ask always lands on a work order: pick the work order and, if you like, its step.
ask.lineWhere: A pattern PDF lands on the order line.
ask.noWorkOrder: This order has no work order yet: a floor ask waits for one.
ask.pricedHint: Then only people who see prices are asked, and only they read the ask.
ask.pricedFloor: The floor never gets files with prices.
ask.sheetHint: Body data: only people with the measurements right are asked and open it.
ask.sheetFloor: A measurement sheet never goes to the floor.

held.words: Say what you need: 3 to 500 characters.
held.step: Whoever works a step: pick the step.

ask.happensOffice: They get a task “Upload: …” in My tasks and Today; when the file comes, you get “Check: …”. Ticking the task by hand closes nothing: the file closes the ask.
ask.happensFloor: The tablets of that team, role or step show it under Files asked; a photo needs the network.
ask.customerTold: The customer: sees nothing — an ask is office only.
ask.never: What never changes. An ask is never deleted: it is accepted or cancelled; the audit keeps who asked, when, and where it lands.
ask.truncated: The list is cut short: not everyone who may be asked is shown.

refusal.stale: Someone changed this ask meanwhile: it was read again.
refusal.forbidden: Your role cannot do this on this order.
refusal.notFound: This ask is not found any more.
refusal.failed: It did not go through: try again.

accept.title: Accept the file for this ask?
accept.notListed: A file you cannot open here
accept.shareHint: It shows in its portal's Documents at once.
accept.version: Accept records these files: a newer version later is not accepted by itself.
accept.shareFailed: Accepted, but sharing did not go through: share it from the file.

again.title: Ask {who} again
again.whyHint: Office only · 3–500 characters; the uploader reads it.
again.what: The same addressee is asked again; the files that came stay on the record.

chase.title: Ask {who} for an update
chase.office: An office note in the order's conversation names the people who hold its task.
chase.floor: The tablets' card says “The office asked for an update”. Nobody is named; nothing says who read it.

reassign.title: Reassign the ask
reassign.floorStays: A floor ask stays on its work order.

cancel.title: Cancel the ask?
cancel.what: Its tasks close as cancelled and the tablets stop showing it; a file already sent stays.

win.never: What never changes. Who asked, when and the history stay; an ask is never deleted.

upload.asksPriced: {name} asks for a file with prices.
